tools.name: start_instance
tools.description: Start a specific game server instance (by id or exact name). Fails if the instance is already running or not in a startable state.

tools.name: stop_instance
tools.description: Stop a specific game server instance (by id or exact name). Set `force: true` to forcefully kill a hung process (may cause data loss).

tools.name: restart_instance
tools.description: Restart a specific game server instance (by id or exact name). Attempts a graceful stop first then starts it again.

tools.name: wake_instance

tools.name: get_instance_metrics

tools.name: get_instance_usage_history

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "list_files" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_upgrade_link, get_instance_metrics, search_knowledgebase, get_jit_share, list_tickets, get_ticket, create_ticket, reply_to_ticket, list_online_players · Private data: search_game_files, list_file_releases, manage_instance, get_connection_info, get_settings, set_settings, get_jit_share, set_jit_share, create_database, delete_database, get_database_info, reset_database_password, restore_backup, list_files, search_files, read_file, write_file, edit_file, copy_path, move_path, delete_path, compress_paths, extract_archive, create_backup · Public sink: search_knowledgebase, get_jit_share, set_jit_share, regenerate_jit_share_url, reply_to_ticket, send_console_command · Destructive: get_dedicated_server_info, stop_instance, remove_user_access, update_port, delete_port, delete_database, reset_database_password, delete_backup, delete_task, write_file, copy_path, delete_path.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_upgrade_link, get_instance_metrics, search_knowledgebase, get_jit_share, list_tickets, get_ticket, create_ticket, reply_to_ticket, list_online_players · Private data: search_game_files, list_file_releases, manage_instance, get_connection_info, get_settings, set_settings, get_jit_share, set_jit_share, create_database, delete_database, get_database_info, reset_database_password, restore_backup, list_files, search_files, read_file, write_file, edit_file, copy_path, move_path, delete_path, compress_paths, extract_archive, create_backup · Public sink: search_knowledgebase, get_jit_share, set_jit_share, regenerate_jit_share_url, reply_to_ticket, send_console_command · Destructive: get_dedicated_server_info, stop_instance, remove_user_access, update_port, delete_port, delete_database, reset_database_password, delete_backup, delete_task, write_file, copy_path, delete_path

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
